clips.title: The story
paras: At Northwatch Hold, Theramore Medal marks service among the marines and officers defending the outpost along the Merchant Coast. The insignia bears Theramore’s mark and identifies the Alliance garrison.

Marines, marksmen, commandos, and officers serving from Northwatch Hold carry stamped medals bearing Theramore’s mark. The soldiers are loyal to Lady Jaina Proudmoore’s realm. For the human troops on the cliffs above the Barrens, the medals show that their service is legitimate and their authority comes from Theramore. Others see the tokens as trophies from an overzealous foreign garrison, one that treats every vessel approaching the coast as a mortal threat.

Northwatch Hold’s gun batteries menace ships along the Merchant Coast, often bombarding privateers and merchantmen alike. After losing ships to the guns, Ratchet privateer Captain Thalo'thas Brightsun seeks the medals. He wants proof that Northwatch’s trigger-happy ranks have paid in blood for sinking his ships, and that the soldiers responsible have been slain in retribution.
